parts.text:
The doorbell camera pings at 3:12 every night. I work the late shift at the hospital, so I watch the recordings at home. Every one shows the same figure, standing perfectly still on my porch with its back to the door.

I told myself it was a prank, until I noticed the date printed on the recordings. It said tomorrow.

Tonight I sat on the porch steps and waited, holding my phone. At 3:12 it pinged, and the new recording showed me from behind, sitting where I sat. Then my front door opened quietly behind me, and something stepped out of the empty house. I felt cold air on my neck as the doorbell camera pinged again.
parts.hook: The doorbell camera pings at 3:12 every night.
